Maya: Follow-up from RFC-2025: proposal to standardize a compact band+shim policy to control kernel explosion. Idea: manifest carries bands with allowed bitwidths and a per-band artifact budget. Runtime uses shims when budget exceeded.

Jon: Sounds good. Two quick asks: 1) how do we prioritize which band entries get compiled vs shimmed? 2) how does ops debug when shims are used?

Maya: Prioritize by sensitivity score (delta-perplexity on calibration) * traffic weight. Build emits an upload report listing compiled vs shimmed bands.

Rui: For debugging, runtime should emit events: `quant_choice` with band, chosen_bitwidth, used_shim true/false, and request_hash. That lets ops correlate regressions.

Elena: Need policy flags: endpoint.quality_tier = strict|balanced|aggressive and manifest.forbid_shim list for security/critical layers.

Jon: What about shape predicates? e.g., seq_len>2048 forces fp8 for some bands. We should allow simple predicates, not arbitrary code.

Maya: Agree. Predicate types limited to shape and batch_size. Example: {band: "attn", predicate: {seq_gt: 2048}, allowed: ["fp8"]}.

Rui: Hysteresis: once runtime raises bitwidth for confidence drop, keep it for next M tokens to avoid flip. Emit an event when hysteresis starts/ends.

Elena: Upload probe: run small shadow suite when `--probe-shims` set. If shimbed bands show >X% regression, block or require stricter defaults.

ops-bot: Note: probe adds ~25-40s to upload pipeline depending on model size. See /infra/notes/probe-costs. :gear:

Jon: Also add CLI `ri audit-quant --endpoint E --since 1h` to return band-level bitwidth timeline and shim counts. That should be first-party tooling for SRE.

Maya: Implementation notes: canonicalize artifacts to (bitwidth, seq_bucket, band_id) to cap at ~3 * 2 * bands. Keep supported bitwidths: fp8,int8,int4.

Rui: Good. We'll also add `manifest.min_bitwidth` per band so uploads can't request too-low defaults.

Elena: Action items: Maya draft manifest schema update (PR Tue), Rui runtime event + hysteresis (prototype end of sprint), Jon CLI audit (spec Wed), Elena upload probe flow (PR Thu).

Maya: Thanks. If no objections I'll add to RFC-2025 follow-up. :thumbsup:

Jon: +1

Rui: +1

Elena: +1
